title: piper dolabriforme
intro: Piper dolabriforme, commonly known as Katuk, is a perennial vine native to the tropical forests of the Malay Archipelago. It is a medicinal plant valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Piper dolabriforme include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Katuk are attributed to its ability to scavenge free radicals, inhibit the growth of pathogens, and modulate the immune response, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
